data.description:
## Description

**What**: Update existing project docs (CLAUDE.md, HOOKS-REFERENCE.md, KNOWN-ISSUES.md) to reflect the new wrapper-driven compliance verifier, the `dso commit-override` user command, and the operational patterns surfaced during implementation.

**Why**: Per `.claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md` and the SKILL.md documentation-update-story requirement: future agent sessions need accurate awareness of the new gate, override path, and known operational patterns to avoid rediscovery.

**Scope**:
- IN: `CLAUDE.md` Architecture pointers / Critical Rules (one-line entry pointing to the new pre-commit hook + workflow doc updates); `plugins/dso/docs/HOOKS-REFERENCE.md` (full entry for `pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh`); `KNOWN-ISSUES.md` (operational patterns: hook executable bit; first-run absent dir; ARTIFACTS_DIR in CI; branch-name path divergence; combined skip conditions); `dso-config.conf` reference for `hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled`.
- OUT: creating new doc files; rewriting existing skill docs end-to-end; user-facing tutorial.

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, CLAUDE.md mentions the load-bearing wrapper-driven compliance verifier in the relevant Architecture pointer section, with a one-line link to HOOKS-REFERENCE.md for details.
  ← Satisfies: agent-context awareness
- When this story is complete, HOOKS-REFERENCE.md documents the new `pre-commit-compliance-verifier.sh` hook (purpose, what it reads, when it blocks, how to override).
  ← Satisfies: hook reference completeness
- When this story is complete, KNOWN-ISSUES.md captures the operational patterns surfaced during implementation: hook executable bit preservation; first-run absent dir handling; ARTIFACTS_DIR in CI; branch-name path divergence; combined skip-condition coherence; record-test-status.sh --attest interaction.
  ← Satisfies: operational-patterns documentation
- When this story is complete, dso-config.conf documentation lists `hooks.compliance_verifier.enabled` (default `true` after Story 7 flip) and the relevant skip-condition keys.
  ← Satisfies: config-reference completeness

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Follow `.claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md` for formatting, structure, and conventions.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect HARD-GATE compliance hardening
